descriptionMarkdown:
d8 Injury Until Treated
1 Concussion Disadvantage on the first Intelligence or Wisdom test after each rest.
2 Damaged Arm Cannot use Heavy or two-handed weapons; disadvantage on tasks requiring both hands.
3 Damaged Leg Speed reduced by 10 ft; disadvantage on saves against being knocked prone.
4 Internal Trauma Maximum HP reduced by your character level.
5 Eye Injury Disadvantage on sight-based Perception and ranged attacks beyond normal range.
6 Respiratory Damage Environmental smoke, gas and exertion cause Exposure one step faster when that system 
is in use.
7 Nerve Damage Cannot take reactions during the first round of combat.
8 Severe Scarring No universal combat penalty; choose one social context in which the scar changes 
reactions.
